_doc: Historical nuclear explosions 1945-1998, compiled from the SIPRI/Johnston archive catalog (via the public tidytuesday mirror). FACTUAL event records: date, country, site, yield (kt, upper estimate), type, purpose, location. Compiled 2026-07-11 through the data-quality gate (coord range + null-island, year 1945-1998, yield 0-60000 kt); quarantined records listed in _quarantined. Static historical dataset - the test era ended 1998 (CTBT era); no refresh needed.
source: SIPRI / Johnston archive nuclear explosions catalog (public factual data)
